PROFILE

Bill (Yiqi) Guo is a visual & interaction designer studying at CMU.

Currently Creative Director @ Lunar Gala, previously product design @ Kensho, an S&P Global company.

NOW

I design interfaces and the brand systems around them, then build them in code, including this site.

I care about the small decisions that scale: systematic details, microinteractions, and experiences that bring delight.
